answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 9574 Country: India Title: Do we need to pay zakat on Platinum jwellery and valuable stones like daimond? Question: Do we need to pay zakat on Platinum jwellery and valuable stones like daimond? Answer ID: 9574 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2512/2066=B/1429) The zakah is not wajib on platinum jewels, there is no zakah on diamonds too. Yes, if anyone deals in these items he has to pay the zakah of its price after completion of a year if it reaches up to nisab. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
